The operation involved the replay of containment actions from four prior incidents (INC-2026-0555, INC-2026-0587, INC-2026-0601, INC-2026-0598), including host quarantine, user account disablement, IP blocking, and critical patching. The exercise highlights a gap in automated response consistency and approval workflows for proactive security measures.
